title: Rabbi Yitzchak Kaskasa’ah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Berakhot 51a he explains it before Rabbi Yose bar Avin in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 6, halakhah 1, with the additional historical folio locator 40b, he is called Rabbi Yitzchak bar Mari. Hyman reports that Seder HaDorot divides him into two people.

notes.text: Seder HaDorot’s division into two people is Hyman’s observation. The two names and the full chapter/halakhah/folio locator remain distinct.
The consulted Bavli uses Rav Yitzchak Kaskasa’ah. The Yerushalmi has Rabbi Yitzchak bar Mari and displays a Vilna folio overlay of 44b. Hyman’s historical folio 40b remains as supplied.
